data.one_liner: Shelf handler that upgrades HTTP to WebSocket and provides a WebSocketChannel per connection.
data.what_it_does: It exposes a single function, webSocketHandler, which takes a callback that receives a WebSocketChannel for each new connection. The channel’s stream and sink are used to receive and send messages over the WebSocket.
use_when: Adding WebSocket support to a Shelf-based server
Implementing simple echo or chat services
avoid_when: Building a production-grade WebSocket server that requires advanced routing or subprotocol handling
Using it in a non-Shelf Dart server
strengths: Easy integration with existing Shelf middleware
No additional dependencies beyond shelf and web_socket_channel
weaknesses: Breaking change in 3.0.0 requires callback signature update
Limited to Shelf; not a full-featured WebSocket server framework
No built-in authentication or routing for WebSocket paths
